name: ovos-diagnostics
description: The OVOS Diagnostics Tool is a command-line utility for the Open Voice OS (OVOS) ecosystem. It lists, recommends, and manages plugins across categories such as audio, skills, GUI, language, listener, and platform-specific plugins.
author: TigreGotico

setup_notes.heading: List the installed TTS plugins
setup_notes.content:
To list the available TTS plugins, run:

ovos-diagnostics audio scan-tts
example output
List of TTS Plugins
 0 - ovos-tts-plugin-mimic3
 1 - ovos-tts-plugin-beepspeak
 2 - ovos-tts-plugin-dummy

 4 - ovos-tts-plugin-polly

 6 - ovos-tts-plugin-piper
 7 - ovos-tts-plugin-pico
 8 - ovos-tts-plugin-edge-tts
 9 - ovos-tts-plugin-azure

 11 - ovos-tts-plugin-marytts
 12 - neon-tts-plugin-larynx-server

> NOTE: if a plugin is installed but does not show up here, then ovos-plugin-manager is failing to load it
